Reviewer: egg pool job review-4207 (config .claude-bacon), claude-opus-5-5, login mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Ready for the maintainer to merge, after #4073.** This PR is stacked on #4073. Its branch contains the two #4073 commits (`5d2c2b2d6`, `25b220b34`). This review covers the own commit `d3e8dd705` only. Merge #4073 first, when it has its own clean review. Do not merge this PR before #4073: that would bring in the #4073 code without a review.

Safety tier: no. The diff changes no G-code, no gouge or collision check, no stock simulation and no geometry. It moves display colour constants, and the values do not change.

## What looks good

- The move is exact. The removed blocks in `colorvision.rs` and `ground_ink.rs` are the same text as the added blocks in `theme/verdict.rs`. The names stay associated consts of `Semantic` and `TextInks`, so no call site changes.
- `theme/verdict.rs` has a provenance line and a module comment. It is 149 lines. `colorvision.rs` goes down to 286 lines.
- The pin test holds its own copy of each literal. I compared the copies with the source before the move (`25b220b34`). The `FEED_RGB`, `RAPID_RGB` and `PLUNGE_RGB` values in the test (`[0.20, 0.85, 0.35]`, `[0.30, 0.50, 0.95]`, `[0.92, 0.30, 0.25]`) agree with `crates/ui/src/interact.rs:1011-1013`.
- The test also checks `palette_for` for each mode on each ground.
- `no_theme_key_sets_a_verdict_colour` agrees with the maintainer's words in #1120: the verdict colours do not change value and stay ours.
- The new test is a module of the existing `theme_files` binary (#3187). No new test binary.
- The colour-literal guard removes the `colorvision.rs` row (15) and adds a `keep:` row for `theme/verdict.rs` (15). The rows stay sorted.
- The decision record and the user-guide paragraph are present. `Changelog: none` is correct for a refactor with no change in behaviour.
- The body has before and after screenshots for Off, Protan and Tritan. All six files are on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch.

## Results (trial merge with upstream/main `751a79b20`, built locally on this host)

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 10 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (2.4 min) |
| ui build (`--no-run`) | ok |
| ui suites: lib | 1768 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored (software adapter llvmpipe) |
| ui suites: theme_files | 35 passed, 0 failed (includes both `verdict_inks` tests and both `colour_literals` tests) |
| ui suites: boundary, boundary_picks, contour_dxf_sketch, sinker_setup, tap_hand, theme_example, waterjet_tool | all passed |
| `cargo clippy --no-deps --all-targets -p camcraft-ui -- -D warnings` | clean |

Extra suites run: none were due. The diff does not change `testdata/`, a fixture or golden directory, or the import code.

Heavy lanes: `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` gives 0 steps. The diff reaches no heavy lane.

Light lane: not run. The diff changes only `camcraft-ui` and docs. The light twins are in `motion` and `app`, and this diff does not reach them.

Goldens moved: none. The diff changes no `*.nc`, `*.cl` or `examples/catalog/**` file.

## Mutations

1. In `theme/verdict.rs`, I changed `RED_GREEN.gouge` from `[0.75, 0.10, 0.10]` to `[0.75, 0.10, 0.11]`. Result: `each_colour_vision_palette_keeps_its_values_in_the_token_table` failed with `assertion left == right failed: RED_GREEN`. Red, as expected.
2. In `theme/verdict.rs`, I changed `TRITAN_LIGHT_GROUND.rapid` from `[0.05, 0.05, 0.12]` to `[0.05, 0.05, 0.13]`. Result: the same test failed with `TRITAN_LIGHT_GROUND`. Red, as expected.

I removed the two mutations after the runs. The tree was clean again.

## Requested before merge

None for this commit. The only condition is the merge order: #4073 first.

## Optional, non-blocking

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/colorvision.rs:82-83`: the removal of the `impl TextInks` block leaves two empty lines in sequence. Remove one empty line in a later commit.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
